title: Bram and the Garden Anew
author: Isandro Marchetti
blurb: Zephyrine Marchetti, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, has spent seven years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
